top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises induced-proximity protein degradation as a new chemical mode of action: Crews and Deshaies supplied the PROTAC concept and first cellular demonstrations, and Handa's identification of cereblon as the thalidomide target unifies the PROTAC and molecular-glue strands. The ternary-complex mechanism is confirmed across many laboratories, E3 ligases and targets, so the remaining uncertainty is clinical timing and the third-name choice, not the science. P003 (genetic code expansion) is the mature, cleanly allocated fallback; P002 (Pd-catalysed C-N coupling) is excellent but closer to an extension of a method class already honoured in 2010; no award ranks last because several mature achievements are available.
recusal_note: No tie to any credited laureate in the slate. Field closeness to peptide, protein and biosensing chemistry and a research overlap with Emma Sparr on self-assembly are noted, but they do not bear on P001, P002 or P003; no recusal needed.
